quotes.name: Thrakkus the Butcher
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Somehow, he never seems to run out of fresh meat.

quotes.name: Eternal Taskmaster
quotes.flavor:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Clickslither
quotes.flavor: The least popular goblins get the outer caves.

quotes.name: Angelic Accord
quotes.flavor: As demons are drawn to suffering, angels are drawn to acts of benevolence.

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor: 2013 Legacy Championship Winner

quotes.name: East-Mark Cavalier
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The Rohirrim have long been the friends of the people of Gondor, though they are not akin to them."
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Greater Tanuki
quotes.flavor: The kami permit few mortals to dwell in Jukai Forest, but the clever, playful tanuki are welcomed as friends and guardians.

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Ambassador Oak
quotes.flavor: Treefolk and elves share a common interest in the forests, but really the elves just feel at home with the view from above.

quotes.name: Lórien Revealed
quotes.flavor:
"Look on us now with friendly eyes! Behold the trees of the Naith of Lórien and be glad!"
—Haldir

quotes.name: Inner Fire
quotes.flavor: "Heart of Sokenzan, I call to you! Lend me your fire."

quotes.name: Borderland Ranger
quotes.flavor: "There's only one route from Kessig into Stensia. Unless you come with me."

quotes.name: Deepwood Tantiv
quotes.flavor: A single tantiv is just as dangerous as a herd.

quotes.name: Thundering Giant
quotes.flavor: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

quotes.name: Wall of Granite
quotes.flavor: The wisest man builds his house *behind* the rock.

quotes.name: Clown Extruder
quotes.flavor: Pietra's Mirthing Pod boasts an output that's hilarious and impressive—a real laugh a minute.

quotes.name: City of Brass
quotes.flavor:
"There is much to learn here, but few can endure the ringing of the spires."
—Nulakam the Archivist

quotes.name: Reya Dawnbringer
quotes.flavor: "As my light rises on the battlefield, my followers rise from it."

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominaria's grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Ill-Timed Explosion
quotes.flavor: Only too late did the Agency custodians realize the device had not been inactive—it was just waiting for the right trigger.

quotes.name: Hraesvelgr of the First Brood
quotes.flavor: "Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten."

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Arc-Slogger
quotes.flavor: A shuffling sound and the smell of ozone follow the slogger as surely as its electric tail.

quotes.name: Overgrown Tomb
quotes.flavor: The elf was disgusted by the bramble before him when the skies darkened, then he stepped closer to observe the wild beauty.

quotes.name: Doc Ock's Henchmen
quotes.flavor: "Don't be a hero, Gary! We don't get paid enough for a scrap with Spider-Man!"

quotes.name: Sage Aven
quotes.flavor: From their mountain aeries, aven scholars see far more than the distant horizon.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"One day, maybe, kids will play here again."
—Preston Garvey

quotes.name: Bloodthorn Taunter
quotes.flavor: Naya's celebrants stoke the gargantuans into a rage, loosing a tide of muscle with the precision of an arrow.

quotes.name: Aron, Benalia's Ruin
quotes.flavor:
"He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone."
—Danitha

quotes.name: Mobilization
quotes.flavor: Wars are won with strength, valor, and numbers—especially numbers.

quotes.name: Secluded Starforge
quotes.flavor: The heat of a sun condensed into a forge.

quotes.name: Ley Druid
quotes.flavor: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

quotes.name: Urza's Armor
quotes.flavor: Urza protected his body well, but neglected his soul.

quotes.name: Severed Legion
quotes.flavor: No one in Aphetto answers a knock at the door after sundown.

quotes.name: Curiosity
quotes.flavor: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

quotes.name: Grand Crescendo
quotes.flavor: The roar of applause drowned out the melee raging in the lobby.

quotes.name: Diminish
quotes.flavor:
"'That was a narrow escape!' said Alice, a good deal frightened at the sudden change, but very glad to find herself still in existence."
—Lewis Carroll,
*Alice's Adventures in Wonderland*

quotes.name: Kaalia of the Vast
quotes.flavor: "I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."

quotes.name: Mindslaver
quotes.flavor: It's a helm that leaves the head at its most vulnerable.

quotes.name: Knotvine Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"He is part of a new breed of guardian, one who embraces the best of both his world and ours."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Grazing Gladehart
quotes.flavor:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

quotes.name: Wrecking Ball
quotes.flavor: Rakdos festivals almost leave enough rubble in their wake to hide the bodies.

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor: S.H.I.E.L.D. keeps watch over the land, sea, and stars.

quotes.name: Exquisite Firecraft
quotes.flavor: Chandra's gift set her apart and others aflame.

quotes.name: Kolvori, God of Kinship // The Ringhart Crest
quotes.flavor: Kolvori's love for her family knows no bounds.

quotes.name: Uninvited Geist // Unimpeded Trespasser
quotes.flavor: Knocking was simply a formality.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"The wilds are unpredictable. Rivers change course, trees shuffle and bend, rocks split and scurry. But mark my words, traveler—the main thing that'll change out there is *you*."
—Sturwynn, Boundary Lands ranger

quotes.name: Reflections of Littjara
quotes.flavor: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

quotes.name: Infuse with the Elements
quotes.flavor:
"Zendikar has given us the weapons to wage war on the appropriate scale."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

quotes.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
quotes.flavor:
"For every living person there are generations of dead. Which realm would you rather rule?"
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Mogg Conscripts
quotes.flavor:
"Torahn's horns! They've seen us. Now, statue, you must fight to save yourself!"
—Tahngarth, aboard the *Predator*

quotes.name: Foothill Guide
quotes.flavor: "Like any pests, goblins must be repelled quickly or they multiply."

quotes.name: Companion of the Trials
quotes.flavor:
"The fiercest loyalties are earned in battle."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elder
quotes.flavor:
"Do we know what we're doing? Yes—the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

quotes.name: Sedris, the Traitor King
quotes.flavor: He bids his minions rise from their graves to their knees.

quotes.name: Beetleback Chief
quotes.flavor: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

quotes.name: Threaten
quotes.flavor: Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

quotes.name: Ascendant Evincar
quotes.flavor:
"Things are going to change around here."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Strix Serenade
quotes.flavor: Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.

quotes.name: Nim Shrieker
quotes.flavor: As imps they were an annoyance. As nim they are a pestilence.

quotes.name: Ogre Savant
quotes.flavor: He's an oxymoron.

quotes.name: Bolt Bend
quotes.flavor:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Floodbringer
quotes.flavor: "Such a small thing, a drop of water . . . And yet enough of them together can flood a field, cleanse a mire, or choke a forest."

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor: The priests plead for your anguish and pray for your despair.

quotes.name: Excavating Anurid
quotes.flavor: Turg's spawn ruled long after he croaked.

quotes.name: Ironscale Hydra
quotes.flavor:
"Put down your bows, you fools! Arrows only make it angry!"
—Callia, Hyrax Tower scout

quotes.name: Training Center
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes you just need to be inspired by a massive explosion or a color that didn't exist five seconds ago."
—Rootha, Prismari mage-student

quotes.name: Orcish Artillery
quotes.flavor:
"So they want to kill my men? Well two can play at that game."
—General Khurzog

quotes.name: Wei Scout
quotes.flavor:
"He will win who, prepared himself, waits to take the enemy unprepared."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

quotes.name: HYDRA Troopers
quotes.flavor: Evil never lacks foot soldiers to do its will.

quotes.name: A.I.M. Bot
quotes.flavor: "Thank you for visiting the Advanced Idea Mechanics laboratory. You will now be eradicated. Goodbye!"

quotes.name: Seer's Lantern
quotes.flavor: A light to bring hope in dark times.

quotes.name: Fractured Identity
quotes.flavor:
"It's like I'm breaking into a million pieces and there's only one thing I remember. I have to save the Doctor."
—Clara Oswald

quotes.name: Muscle Burst
quotes.flavor: As strong as a centaur's will.

quotes.name: Gravespawn Sovereign
quotes.flavor: The Cabal never expected its creations to create servants of their own.

quotes.name: Yet Another Aether Vortex
quotes.flavor: It puts the "vortex" in "flavortext."

quotes.name: Amulet of Vigor
quotes.flavor:
"Angels guide me while I wake,
and I will watch for evil's creep.
Angels guard me while I dream,
and I will rest in peaceful sleep."
—Amulet inscription

quotes.name: Entrapment Maneuver
quotes.flavor: Every squad of deathclaw hunters had a role for the newbies: bait.

quotes.name: Mirran Spy
quotes.flavor: Accurate information is a precious commodity in times of war.

quotes.name: Canopy Spider
quotes.flavor: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

quotes.name: Boneyard Scourge
quotes.flavor: Death arrives on tattered wings and stolen bones.

quotes.name: Juniper Order Rootweaver
quotes.flavor: "What Phyrexia takes, the grace of Freyalise shall replenish."

quotes.name: Empty the Warrens
quotes.flavor:
Kicking the warren
—Argivian expression meaning "causing trouble"

quotes.name: Koala-Sheep
quotes.flavor: Koala-sheep can fall asleep anywhere, and often do.

quotes.name: Prodigal Pyromancer
quotes.flavor: "What am I looking at? Ashes, dead man."

quotes.name: Screeching Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"What wears down my people most, I think, is not the danger, but the endless screeching outside our camp."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

quotes.name: The Ghoul, Gunslinger
quotes.flavor: "Feo, fuerte, y formal."

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Simoon
quotes.flavor: Hot wind whipped up as if the weather itself wanted to fight Phyrexians.

quotes.name: Army of the Damned
quotes.flavor: Sometimes death comes knocking. Sometimes it tears down the walls.

quotes.name: Blinding Mage
quotes.flavor: "I carry the light of truth. Do not pity those it blinds, for they never had eyes to see."

quotes.name: Vesuvan Duplimancy
quotes.flavor:
"There hasn't been an original thought on Vesuva in centuries."
—Emmest, Tolarian chronicler

quotes.name: Vraska's Conquistador
quotes.flavor: Abandoning both queen and church, he chose to follow power.

quotes.name: Liliana's Mastery
quotes.flavor: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

quotes.name: Smashing Success
quotes.flavor:
"Who said there's no profit in destruction?"
—Magda, brazen outlaw

quotes.name: Ogre Resister
quotes.flavor: He didn't have a word for "home," but he knew it was something to be defended.

quotes.name: Energy Flux
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing endures but change."
—Heraclitus

quotes.name: Park Map
quotes.flavor: It's always up-to-date, so visitors know what rides are open, how long the lines are, and which areas are closed due to gremlins.

quotes.name: Loyal Subordinate
quotes.flavor: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

quotes.name: Caves of Koilos
quotes.flavor: After years of silence, the caves once again echo with the grisly sounds of Phyrexians preparing for war.

quotes.name: Mourner's Surprise
quotes.flavor: "Y'all should've known better than to buy me a coffin!"

quotes.name: Stoic Sphinx
quotes.flavor: Lucky travelers reported a mighty winged creature among the geysers. Unlucky ones didn't make it back.

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: The angel remembers her past lives like dreams. Her song held up meadows. Her blade drove back darkness. Her wings carried her across the ages.

quotes.name: King's Assassin
quotes.flavor: Fear is as effective a weapon as the blade.

quotes.name: Chart a Course
quotes.flavor: While other pirates prowl for treasure, Captain Parrish plunders secrets.

quotes.name: Strands of Night
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the night torn into thin darkling strips and woven into shapes too bleak for dreams."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Sacred Ground
quotes.flavor: The knight knelt and prayed, first for the sanctity of his land and second for the strength to repel its invaders.

quotes.name: Starport Security
quotes.flavor: "You are a suspect in an ongoing investigation. Do not resist apprehension."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Myr Kinsmith
quotes.flavor:
"Our resistance is like the myr: small and easily overlooked, but loyal and resilient beyond measure."
—Melira

quotes.name: Monologue Tax
quotes.flavor:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

quotes.name: Immortal Phoenix
quotes.flavor: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

quotes.name: Homeward Path
quotes.flavor:
"I felt like a stranger here, at first. But I've made a lot of friends! For once, I feel like I belong . . ."
—Leo

quotes.name: Living Library
quotes.flavor:
"Too many lives have been cut short, too many of their futures untold. I can rewrite them. I can give them a voice."
—The Theorist, Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Bitter Triumph
quotes.flavor:
「野心は偉大なる力や深い悲しみをもたらす。しかし、両方がもたらされたときのことを覚悟できている者はいない。」
――「リーダーシップとその帰結」

quotes.name: Iceridge Serpent
quotes.flavor:
"Even dragons avoid Glintglaze Lake in this season. Which of you youngsters can tell me why?"
—Teacher Eliam

quotes.name: Destructive Force
quotes.flavor: The end of the world rarely comes quietly.

quotes.name: Endless Atlas
quotes.flavor: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

quotes.name: Guardian of Pilgrims
quotes.flavor: Immune to the physical warping caused by Emrakul, geists proved to be some of humanity's most important allies.

quotes.name: Fighting Drake
quotes.flavor: Scholars in their ivory towers call them "sharks of the sky." Scholars on the road don't call them at all.

quotes.name: La Forge, Perceptive Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Captain, the sensor sweep is fine, but my VISOR is picking up some disturbing fluctuations in the dilithium crystal matrix."

quotes.name: Black Market Tycoon
quotes.flavor: "I have exactly what you need. The question is, how badly do you need it?"

quotes.name: Reflections of Littjara
quotes.flavor: The masks float downstream toward the Mirrorlake, where faces arise to wear them.

quotes.name: Midnight Banshee
quotes.flavor: Many have heard the beginning of its low, sustained shriek but few the end.

quotes.name: Trail of Evidence
quotes.flavor:
"Every answer seems to lead to a more terrifying question."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Giant Spectacle
quotes.flavor: The giant-decorating contest at the migration festival is a tradition that may have started as a dare.

quotes.name: Fodder Cannon
quotes.flavor: Step 1: Find your cousin. Step 2: Get your cousin in the cannon. Step 3: Find another cousin.

quotes.name: Dragon's Eye Sentry
quotes.flavor: Even the humblest guard of Ojutai's strongholds ponders the puzzles of the Great Teacher's lessons.

quotes.name: Outrageous Robbery
quotes.flavor:
"When you can't erase your own trail, leave as many false ones as possible."
—Etrata

quotes.name: Bard, Heir of Girion
quotes.flavor: With strength of arms, Bard demonstrated the might once possessed by the old lords of Dale.

quotes.name: Hard Cover
quotes.flavor: A good book is a refuge, but a great book is a fortress.

quotes.name: Brandywine Farmer
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Your land must be a realm of peace and content, and there must gardeners be in high honor."
—Faramir

quotes.name: Song-Mad Treachery // Song-Mad Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"They call it the Singing City, but those eerie sounds aren't music. They worm their way into your brain until rational thought is impossible."
—Yavotz, Sea Gate Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Boneknitter
quotes.flavor: Nothing comes together as easily as it comes apart.

quotes.name: Time Walk
quotes.flavor: 2022 North America Vintage Championship

quotes.name: Arcane Melee
quotes.flavor: Debates between wizards are never purely academic.

quotes.name: Mystical Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"To the tutors, a 'poem of sand' was of little account, a 'poem of ivory,' priceless."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: Whenever the Llanowar Elves gather the fruits of their forest, they leave one plant of each type untouched, considering that nature's portion.

quotes.name: Angel of Mercy
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Every tear shed is a drop of immortality.

quotes.name: Odric, Master Tactician
quotes.flavor: "Fear holds no place in faith's battle plan."

quotes.name: Darksteel Mutation
quotes.flavor: Infinitely powerless.

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor:
Watching the spider's web
—Llanowar expression meaning "focusing on the wrong thing"

quotes.name: Emergence Zone
quotes.flavor: The Planar Bridge opened over the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing the symbol of Ravnica's endurance to rubble.

quotes.name: Words of Wilding
quotes.flavor:
"Instinct is undaunted by terror, unchained by logic. It is the path from which all other paths diverge."
—*Volume V, The Book of Life*

quotes.name: Overwhelming Forces
quotes.flavor: Town Takeover! Sterling Company Expands Territory Again

quotes.name: Martyr of Frost
quotes.flavor:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Zulaport Cutthroat
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

quotes.name: Plagued Rusalka
quotes.flavor:
"Look at her, once filled with innocence. Death has a way of wringing away such . . . deficiencies."
—Savra

quotes.name: Guul Draz Mucklord
quotes.flavor: Death comes in many forms on Guul Draz, most of them slow, subtle, and agonizing. At least a monstrous crocodile offers a swift death.

quotes.name: Damping Sphere
quotes.flavor: A Thran relic, it has spent ten thousand years doing absolutely nothing.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Assemble the Players
quotes.flavor:
"All will soon be made clear, but I can give you this: our killer is here with us, in this very room."
—Alquist Proft

quotes.name: Moonstone Harbinger
quotes.flavor: Moonstone weapons drink in the last light of dusk to give their wielders an edge in combat.

quotes.name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
quotes.flavor: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

quotes.name: Anticipate
quotes.flavor: Divining the future is easy when you hold the power to sway it.

quotes.name: Quasiduplicate
quotes.flavor: "My greatest creation—me!"

quotes.name: Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor
quotes.flavor: "Perfection is elusive. Let us try again."

quotes.name: Rip Apart
quotes.flavor: Torn from history. Torn from memory. Torn from reality.

quotes.name: Elite Arrester
quotes.flavor: "Hold it! I need to see your papers."

quotes.name: Drastic Revelation
quotes.flavor: Every disaster holds mystery, for lack of a sane witness.

quotes.name: Dross Skullbomb
quotes.flavor: It seethes with the ambition of a ruthless gladiator.

quotes.name: Wall of Junk
quotes.flavor: Urza saw the wall and realized that even if he tore every Phyrexian to pieces, they would still resist him.

quotes.name: Goblin Bombardment
quotes.flavor: There's always a waiting list to join the Goblin Bombadeers—the retirement benefits are amazing!

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Evil Eye of Orms-by-Gore
quotes.flavor: The highway of fear is the shortest route to defeat.

quotes.name: Namor, Atlantean King
quotes.flavor: "IMPERIUS REX!"

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

quotes.name: Wings of Hubris
quotes.flavor: Dalakos's invention worked . . . until it didn't.

quotes.name: Willow Geist
quotes.flavor: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

quotes.name: Witherbloom Campus
quotes.flavor: Mage-students fascinated by the energies of life and death choose Witherbloom, the college of essence studies.

quotes.name: Dreadbore
quotes.flavor: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

quotes.name: Battlefront Krushok
quotes.flavor: Krushoks clear debris from fertile fields, fallow fields, and battlefields.

quotes.name: Wolfkin Outcast // Wedding Crasher
quotes.flavor: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

quotes.name: Awaken the Woods
quotes.flavor:
"We expected the Argothians to stand their ground. We didn't expect the ground itself to stand."
—Myrel, Shield of Argive

quotes.name: Mnemonic Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists

quotes.name: Vraska's Contempt
quotes.flavor: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.

quotes.name: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
quotes.flavor:
"Unfortunately, all my test animals have died or escaped, so I shall be the final subject. I feel no fear. This is a momentous night."
—Laboratory notes, final entry

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor: Though you may see the same bones, you'll never see the same skeleton twice.

quotes.name: Divest
quotes.flavor: Flittersprites collect unusually valuable things: coins of fallen empires, baby teeth, and memories of treasured names.

quotes.name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
quotes.flavor:
"I am confident that if anyone actually penetrates our facades, even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir."
—Szadek

quotes.name: Unnatural Growth
quotes.flavor: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

quotes.name: Cradle of Vitality
quotes.flavor: Naya's trees grow tall and sturdy. Their foliage intertwines to form dewcups, rainwater pools where the elves gather to celebrate life.

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood amongst the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Coral Eel
quotes.flavor: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

quotes.name: Treeshaker Chimera
quotes.flavor: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor:
Burl, scurf, and bower
Birth fern and flower.

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Burgeoning
quotes.flavor:
"The plants said, 'We will fight the stone with root and stem and seed. We are patient. We will win.'"
—Skyshroud myth of the forest

quotes.name: Augur il-Vec
quotes.flavor: "If it would end this exile, my life is yours."

quotes.name: Ray of Dissolution
quotes.flavor: The works of one god last only as long as the patience of another.

quotes.name: Tuinvale Treefolk // Oaken Boon
quotes.flavor: "Right now you are a feeble stick, but I will help you grow some rings."

quotes.name: Horned Turtle
quotes.flavor: Its spear has no shaft, its shield no handle.

quotes.name: Steeple Creeper
quotes.flavor:
"If the Fin Clade cannot produce a reliable venomous krasis, mobile in both air and water, then the Guardian Project will absorb its resources."
—Vannifar

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Accursed Marauder
quotes.flavor: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

quotes.name: Swordsman's Steel
quotes.flavor: "How perfectly it sings as it slices! Encore!"

quotes.name: Introduction to Annihilation
quotes.flavor:
"I've never seen a student fail quite so spectacularly. There's potential in that."
—Hostram, professor of arcanochemistry

quotes.name: Juniper Order Advocate
quotes.flavor:
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order advocate

quotes.name: Morkrut Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Let's see my brother's stitched-up little toys compete with this."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Guardian Project
quotes.flavor: Simic's strength comes from its diversity.

quotes.name: Pit Scorpion
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the smallest nuisance can be the greatest pain.

quotes.name: Curse of Vitality
quotes.flavor: Good health beckons many a vigorous follower.

quotes.name: Burglar Rat
quotes.flavor:
"Even rats hoard their treasures. Are your precious things so different?"
—Izoni

quotes.name: Corrupt
quotes.flavor: One misstep in the swamp and the evil that sleeps beneath will rise to find you.

quotes.name: Goblin Bombardment
quotes.flavor: With one motion, a pest is removed and a scourge inflicted.

quotes.name: Grixis Panorama
quotes.flavor: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

quotes.name: Qiqirn Merchant
quotes.flavor: Small Beastmen that live alongside humans in the Aht Urhgan Empire. Their ancestors were nomads in the north, and their unique culture and customs can be seen even now.

quotes.name: Wild Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"I abandoned my dream of a squadron of griffin-riders when the cost proved too high. Three trainers were eaten for every griffin broken to the bridle."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Crafty Cutpurse
quotes.flavor: Possession is eleven-tenths of the pirate code.

quotes.name: Uncle Istvan
quotes.flavor: Solitude drove the old hermit insane. Now he only keeps company with those he can catch.

quotes.name: Minister of Pain
quotes.flavor: Draconic words need not be shouted. A whisper will suffice.

quotes.name: Vendetta
quotes.flavor: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

quotes.name: Tower of Eons
quotes.flavor: Its etchings tell the ur-golems' stories of an entity able to force life into a lifeless plane.

quotes.name: Gang Up
quotes.flavor:
"Well, who do we have here, Gorm?"
"No one, Virtus. No one at all."

quotes.name: Exclusion Mage
quotes.flavor: Successful battles start with knowing who's worth fighting.

quotes.name: My Precious // Allure of Power
quotes.flavor: "It won't see us, will it, my precious?"

quotes.name: Vexing Bauble
quotes.flavor: No one knew who invented it. No one knew its purpose. All anyone knew was they didn't like being anywhere near it.

quotes.name: Bloodfell Caves
quotes.flavor: Having learned of New Capenna's Halo supply, Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa herself to bring the world to heel.

quotes.name: Doom Blade
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor:
"One little word was all it took. The world shook as I said it. The doom of Zendikar was here at last."
—Ob Nixilis

quotes.name: Viashino Spearhunter
quotes.flavor: Viashino lack the majesty of their draconic ancestors, but they lash out with equal rage and twice the spite.

quotes.name: Aradara Express
quotes.flavor: It glides around the city, a sublime combination of elegance and utility.

quotes.name: Divination
quotes.flavor:
"Half of your studies will be learning the laws of magic. The other half will be bending them."
—Naru Meha, master wizard

quotes.name: Illusionary Wall
quotes.flavor:
"Let them see what is not there and feel what does not touch them. When they no longer trust their senses, that is the time to strike."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root
quotes.flavor: "Life is as fleeting as it is vibrant. Embrace the brief blessing of a flower before it withers."

quotes.name: Freejam Regent
quotes.flavor: The dragons perching in Freejam's towers symbolize the zone's fierce independence.

quotes.name: Wicker Witch
quotes.flavor: When there were no more crows to scare, it focused its efforts elsewhere.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"Una vez vi a un trasgo gritándole a una tormenta eléctrica. Perdió la discusión bastante rápido."
—Mago errante

quotes.name: Skycat Sovereign
quotes.flavor: The bounty on its head is as old as Skysail, but no one has ever tried to collect.

quotes.name: Sangrophage
quotes.flavor: The living is all it eats.

quotes.name: Healer of the Pride
quotes.flavor: "No life is without meaning. No living thing is too small to be strong."

quotes.name: Consuming Bonfire
quotes.flavor:
"The elves use treefolk to drive us away. It is time to remove their tools."
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

quotes.name: Maralen of the Mornsong
quotes.flavor: Maralen sent Veesa, Endry, and Iliona—the Vendilion clique—on the gravest of tasks.

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: "Catch!"

quotes.name: Village Rites
quotes.flavor:
"My colleagues revile the barbarity of the Blood Age, but I believe we have much to learn from the magics of endless war."
—Embrose, Silverquill dean

quotes.name: Oblation
quotes.flavor: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

quotes.name: Corpsejack Menace
quotes.flavor: Weakness is not in the nature of the Swarm.

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as the Cabal encroaches.

quotes.name: Ruthless Sniper
quotes.flavor: "You may feel a slight sting."

quotes.name: Poison the Cup
quotes.flavor: Dark schemes cut down what armies cannot.

quotes.name: Vampire Bats
quotes.flavor: "For something is amiss or out of place/ When mice with wings can wear a human face." —Theodore Roethke, "The Bat"

quotes.name: For the Emperor!
quotes.flavor: They all took up the cry, the missionaries, the pilgrims, the sisters of the Orders Militant. The forces of Chaos melted before the fire of their faith.

quotes.name: Bloodsworn Steward
quotes.flavor: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

quotes.name: Sphinx of Foresight
quotes.flavor: "I do not understand the future I see: the guilds subverted, the world at war, armies bent to a cruel conqueror's will."

quotes.name: Netcaster Spider
quotes.flavor: In the jungles of Tazeem, aerial assault is not always advantageous.

quotes.name: Goblin Oriflamme
quotes.flavor:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Whisperer of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: She speaks only in whispers but can be heard over the fiercest storm.

quotes.name: Twisted Embrace
quotes.flavor: Evil kami are drawn to mortals who share their grim fascinations.

quotes.name: Meekstone
quotes.flavor: The bigger they are, the stronger its pull.

quotes.name: Tireless Hauler // Dire-Strain Brawler
quotes.flavor: A few townsfolk had their suspicions, but none dared accuse him openly.

quotes.name: Cloud Sprite
quotes.flavor: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

quotes.name: Lord of the Undead
quotes.flavor: "I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"

quotes.name: Midnight Reaper
quotes.flavor: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

quotes.name: Spore Crawler
quotes.flavor:
"Remember to come back in a few years when that fungus has died off. Then we'll see what's in the chest."
—Old Rutstein

quotes.name: Aetherize
quotes.flavor: "You can come back once you've learned some manners—and figured out how to reconstitute your physical forms."

quotes.name: Wirefly Hive
quotes.flavor:
"The lifespan of a wirefly can be precisely described as 'short.'"
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

quotes.name: War Room
quotes.flavor: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

quotes.name: Veteran Armorer
quotes.flavor: "Give me a sword and I'll kill a few enemies. But give me a hammer and a fiery forge, and I'll turn the tide of battle."

quotes.name: Subjugate the Hobbits
quotes.flavor:
"This is worse than Mordor! Much worse, in a way. It comes home to you, as they say, because it is a home, and you remember it before it was all ruined."
—Sam

quotes.name: Phantom Carriage
quotes.flavor: Passage to the abyss is free, but the return trip will cost you.

quotes.name: Dockside Extortionist
quotes.flavor: "It's just business."

quotes.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
quotes.flavor:
"He displays a perverse charisma fueled by avarice. Highly dangerous. Recommend civil sanctions."
—Agmand Sarv, Azorius hussar

quotes.name: Goblin Chariot
quotes.flavor: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

quotes.name: Pull from Tomorrow
quotes.flavor:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

quotes.name: Ghoulish Procession
quotes.flavor: It was a family reunion to die for.

quotes.name: Theft of Dreams
quotes.flavor: Energy is never lost, only transformed.

quotes.name: City of Brass
quotes.flavor: To walk its streets is to burn in its beauty.

quotes.name: Nightshade Stinger
quotes.flavor:
"Most faeries are harmless pranksters. Every now and again, though, you get one that crosses over from mischievous to malicious."
—Gaddock Teeg

quotes.name: Morbius the Living Vampire
quotes.flavor: "Nothing matters—except the ravening thirst of Morbius! A thirst which must be quenched!"

quotes.name: Gorilla Chieftain
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, no—not *you* again?!"
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Prowess of the Fair
quotes.flavor: An elvish duel is a thing of beauty: the warriors' grace, the crash of steel, then the artful spray of blood.

quotes.name: Boompile
quotes.flavor:
"Fuses? We have more than enough! Now . . . which one was it?"
—Flearan One-Eye, goblin engineer

quotes.name: Painful Truths
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor: Many a besieged city has surrendered upon hearing the distinctive rumble of the juggernaut.

quotes.name: Kalonian Hydra
quotes.flavor: Even baloths fear its feeding time.

quotes.name: Steward of Valeron
quotes.flavor: www.MagicTheGathering.com

quotes.name: Crypt Incursion
quotes.flavor: The Golgari maze-runner Varolz hungers to prove his fortitude in battle, and his trail of victims feeds other hungers.

quotes.name: Flash Counter
quotes.flavor: "So much for that bright idea!"

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

quotes.name: Sleep Paralysis
quotes.flavor: Sleep doesn't always mean rest.

quotes.name: Thundering Ceratok
quotes.flavor:
"I thought this was a civilized plane. How are there so many feral beasts?"
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Ancient Craving
quotes.flavor: Knowledge demands sacrifice.

quotes.name: Swift Justice
quotes.flavor:
"Having conviction is more important than being righteous."
—Aurelia

quotes.name: Aura Thief
quotes.flavor: Illusion steals reality from the unwise.

quotes.name: Exclude
quotes.flavor:
"Terrifying, but thankfully temporary."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

quotes.name: Brought Back
quotes.flavor:
"As long as your courage remains, your life will not falter."
—Sephara, Sky's Blade

quotes.name: Pathbreaker Ibex
quotes.flavor:
"Not only a wrecking ball, but a trendsetter in its own right."
—Crocodile Jackson, legendary cowboy

quotes.name: Advocate of the Beast
quotes.flavor: "I am neither their drover nor their leader. To these majestic beasts, I am simply their herdmate and nothing more."

quotes.name: Black Hole
quotes.flavor:
"Code Dark Donut! Code Dark Donut! All available fun specialists, please report to the Roil Coaster immediately!"
—Truss, chief engineer

quotes.name: Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher
quotes.flavor: "I find a world where the herds finally listen to me, but now the *plants* have an attitude?"

quotes.name: Veteran Cavalier
quotes.flavor:
Spirit is the sword and experience the sharpening stone.
—Arabian proverb

quotes.name: Hermit Druid
quotes.flavor: "The woods are not unknowable. Certainty and order are woven with the roots."

quotes.name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov are not the only religious tradition on Ravnica, nor the oldest.

quotes.name: Dimir Locket
quotes.flavor:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

quotes.name: Poppet Stitcher // Poppet Factory
quotes.flavor: It may have been a mistake to give them minds of their own.

quotes.name: Spinny Ride
quotes.flavor: Located on the opposite side of the park from the food court, for obvious reasons.

quotes.name: Lieutenant Kirtar
quotes.flavor:
"His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same."
—Pianna, nomad captain

quotes.name: Scientist Supreme of A.I.M.
quotes.flavor: "A weapon to kill a god? A.I.M. can do that, if you have the money."

quotes.name: Seven Dwarves
quotes.flavor:
"Till I hit that lode and find great treasure."
"Away swing away, strike the ore true."

quotes.name: Angelic Blessing
quotes.flavor: The man who rose up to fight was not the same man knocked down.

quotes.name: Primeval Force
quotes.flavor: It has germinated in the earth for thousands of years. Finally it wakes to the battle's call.

quotes.name: Wolfhunter's Quiver
quotes.flavor:
"Steel in the heart, silver in the bow."
—Wolfhunter's creed

quotes.name: Nakaya Shade
quotes.flavor: Made strong by reckless magic. Made horrid by reckless strife.

quotes.name: Displacer Kitten
quotes.flavor:
"Isn't she the cutest thing you've almost seen?"
—Doen, purveyor of exotic pets

quotes.name: Assassinate
quotes.flavor:
"This is how wars are won—not with armies of soldiers but with a single knife blade, artfully placed."
—Yurin, royal assassin

quotes.name: Onyx Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We wield death and darkness, powers that make lesser mages tremble in fear."
—Onyx creed

quotes.name: Bone Picker
quotes.flavor: They are the first to greet dissenters on their journey into exile.

quotes.name: Mephitic Vapors
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's safest strongholds are often neither.

quotes.name: Collector Protector
quotes.flavor: "Here—have a Mudhole."

quotes.name: Tinker
quotes.flavor:
"I wonder how it feels to be bored."
—Jhoira, artificer

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Feldon of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: "She will come back to me."

quotes.name: Aegis of the Heavens
quotes.flavor: Inner strength is never seen until it makes all the difference.

quotes.name: Crippling Blight
quotes.flavor:
"Still alive? No matter. I'll leave you as a warning to others who would oppose me."
—Vish Kal, Blood Arbiter

quotes.name: April O'Neil, Hacktivist
quotes.flavor: In the fight between mutants, ninjas, and aliens, don't underestimate a resourceful human.

quotes.name: Virus Beetle
quotes.flavor: The Eumidian biotechs were delighted when a mutated malware gene devastated their systems. They'd encourage the trait, so long as future clutches could be contained.

quotes.name: Island
quotes.flavor: After careful study, you've determined that the giant ruins served to track the movement of the planets ... and they will soon align once more.

quotes.name: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.

quotes.name: Reverse the Sands
quotes.flavor: Worse than the years of aging was the burden of memory. The young monk lost his youth and gained a vicarious lifetime of hardship and woe.

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor: "I found a new toy. Wanna play?"

quotes.name: Graxiplon
quotes.flavor:
"Attempts to revive this ancient species have not been entirely successful, but results indicate potential for future development."
—Riptide Project researcher

quotes.name: Urza's Tower
quotes.flavor: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

quotes.name: Yathan Roadwatcher
quotes.flavor: She keeps watch for dragonstorms and rival clans alike. For dragons, she raises an alarm. For thieves, her blade.

quotes.name: Lava Coil
quotes.flavor:
「司令官、ディミーアのスパイを捕らえ、その遺灰を監禁しました。」
――ウォジェクの警備兵、クラム

quotes.name: Arcane Spyglass
quotes.flavor: It breaches not physical distances but temporal ones.

quotes.name: Afterburner Expert
quotes.flavor: Speedbump has miraculously survived ninety-nine rocket crashes, and he's aiming for an even hundred.

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Shoreline Salvager
quotes.flavor:
"They search for treasures that wash up from the depths. Tracking one could lead you to riches. Or in circles."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Strength of the Pack
quotes.flavor: The pack that ambushes, eviscerates, and devours together stays together.

quotes.name: Deserted Beach
quotes.flavor: Drownyard floods and unnatural frost made the once peaceful boardwalk deceptively treacherous.

quotes.name: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan
quotes.flavor: Swimming in coins proved harder than they'd hoped, but dancing was a jingling delight.

quotes.name: Darksteel Relic
quotes.flavor:
"It's the last thing we can call our own."
—Minhu, Mirran resistance

quotes.name: Krovikan Fetish
quotes.flavor: Some Krovikans find strength in the ears and eyes of their victims and wear such fetishes into battle.

quotes.name: Contract Killing
quotes.flavor: For a price, the floating city of High and Dry offers all the amenities a pirate could want: rest, recreation, and revenge.

quotes.name: Ravenous Rats
quotes.flavor: Nada es sagrado para las ratas. Todo es simplemente otra comida.

quotes.name: Caldera Kavu
quotes.flavor: As powerful and malleable as the molten rock it calls home.

quotes.name: Sevinne, the Chronoclasm
quotes.flavor: "The best moments are worth reliving."

quotes.name: Sliversmith
quotes.flavor: After centuries of labor, its creations outnumber those they were to mimic.

quotes.name: Carapace
quotes.flavor:
"The tougher to crack, the sweeter the snack."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

quotes.name: Lifelink
quotes.flavor: The spoils of war are not measured only in gold and silver.

quotes.name: Rending Flame
quotes.flavor:
"It is our duty to bring the Blessed Sleep to the dead, even if they resist that gift."
—Grete, Order of Saint Traft

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

quotes.name: Illusionary Forces
quotes.flavor:
"This school was founded in secret, operates in secret, and exists for the teaching of secrets. Those who would alter reality must first escape it."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Humiliate
quotes.flavor: "Aw, what's that? No comeback?"

quotes.name: Zulaport Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "Eldrazi? Ha! Try walking through Zulaport at night with your pockets full. Now *that's* dangerous."

quotes.name: Spore Swarm
quotes.flavor: As the irrepressible power of a dormant Multani courses through Yavimaya, the forest passes judgment on travelers and natives alike. Only the fungus prospers.

quotes.name: Volcanic Geyser
quotes.flavor:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

quotes.name: Universal Solvent
quotes.flavor:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

quotes.name: Deserted Beach
quotes.flavor:
"By Silencio Lake. On the Plain of Sighs. An impossible astronaut will rise from the deep. And strike the Time Lord dead."
—Madame Kovarian

quotes.name: Carven Caryatid
quotes.flavor: So-called "old wood" is rare in deforested Ravnica. Statues carved from it are said to house the last of the ancient nature spirits.

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: This is the Sealed Gate... Beyond there is the esper world.

quotes.name: Pandemonium
quotes.flavor:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Benalish Marshal
quotes.flavor:
"Some aspire to climb the mountain of Honor. The Benalish are born upon its peak, and from there ascend among the stars."
—*History of Benalia*

quotes.name: Holy Cow
quotes.flavor: After it passed by, the rancher swore she saw hope shining in the pigs' eyes.

quotes.name: Lord Jyscal Guado
quotes.flavor: "Listen to me very carefully, for I shall tell you the truth about my son, Seymour."

quotes.name: Doomed Traveler
quotes.flavor: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

quotes.name: Mind Over Matter
quotes.flavor:
Lyna turned to the figure beside her. "They're gone. What now?"
"As ever," said Urza, "we wait."

quotes.name: Lowland Giant
quotes.flavor: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

quotes.name: Mind's Eye
quotes.flavor: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

quotes.name: Aven Mindcensor
quotes.flavor: "The only question we need to ask is how best to fulfill the will of the God-Pharaoh."

quotes.name: Blinding Light
quotes.flavor:
"My shield will bear a shining sun so you will always be with me. / Inlaid with gold, it will shine like glowing embers."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

quotes.name: Firefist Striker
quotes.flavor: The flaming fist of Boros holds the promise of both protection and destruction in its grasp.

quotes.name: Crop Rotation
quotes.flavor:
"Life comes at a cost, but steward it well and you will be repaid manyfold."
—Lisette, Witherbloom dean

quotes.name: Dragonlord's Servant
quotes.flavor: The tastiest morsels rarely make it to their intended destination.

quotes.name: Verduran Enchantress
quotes.flavor:
"Graceful? Yes. Beautiful? Absolutely. Harmless? Definitely not."
—Fyndhorn elder

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
quotes.flavor: "Geralf, must you always whine? I agreed to nothing. I'll raise ghouls anytime I wish."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Tower
quotes.flavor:
"A cursed silhouette to look upon. Even if the halls stand empty, its vile shadows blight the land. I shudder to think of the evils that it held."
—Koth

quotes.name: Barkchannel Pathway // Tidechannel Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"Trust in the path, and it will bear you to safety."
—Inga Rune-Eyes

quotes.name: Zuko's Conviction
quotes.flavor: "I've always had to struggle and fight, and that's made me strong."

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: A new civilization was built, bit by bit, from the scrap of the old one.

quotes.name: Simic Ragworm
quotes.flavor:
"Infused with autochthon blood for size and hellion cells for speed, the ragworm is perfect for clearing the undergardens of both rats and vagrants."
—Yolov, Simic bioengineer

quotes.name: Captured by the Consulate
quotes.flavor:
"At last, the infamous Pia Nalaar."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Defiant Strike
quotes.flavor: "My family was saved thanks to a single Boros soldier. It's why I joined the Legion. I will be the protector now."

quotes.name: Chainer's Edict
quotes.flavor: "You forfeited any right to mercy the moment you challenged me."

quotes.name: Tajuru Preserver
quotes.flavor: "No more blood shall be spilled to satisfy another's deluded lust for power."

quotes.name: Ainok Bond-Kin
quotes.flavor: "Hold the line, for family and the fallen!"

quotes.name: Searing Barb
quotes.flavor: "You always were such a sharp student. Shame it took you so long to get the point."

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "I've sworn to protect the people from the horrors that would destroy them—even if those horrors are the angels themselves."

quotes.name: Living End
quotes.flavor:
"Mortality is a gift. There is a comfort in knowing that the end is coming."
—*Vess's Cautions in Necromancy*

quotes.name: Hot Dog Cart
quotes.flavor: "One with everything, please."

quotes.name: Bark-Knuckle Boxer
quotes.flavor:
May your bark be worse than your bite.
—Raccoonfolk war blessing

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: After the thirteenth time Reed Richards overloaded the New York City electric grid, he built the Baxter Building its own power supply.

quotes.name: Jester's Cap
quotes.flavor:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Cartel Aristocrat
quotes.flavor: "Your life serves a higher purpose now: ensuring the continuation of my own."

quotes.name: Ainok Artillerist
quotes.flavor:
"In the Tarkir I once knew, the Abzan revered their ancestor trees. Now, as Dromoka, they cut their finest groves to make weapons."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: Its passage through history is marked by warped desires and insatiable greed.

quotes.name: Gavony Trapper
quotes.flavor: The elite cathars of the Parish-Blades train in all manner of techniques designed to delay and frustrate the beasts that hunt the crossways.

quotes.name: Dominating Vampire
quotes.flavor: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

quotes.name: Ashnod's Altar
quotes.flavor:
"Blood fluting needs to be deeper. Additional hooks needed for nerve rigging. Surface stippling could be coarser."
—Ashnod, design notes

quotes.name: Desert Were-Worm
quotes.flavor:
Fight wild Were-worms in the Last Desert
—Expression meaning "an impossible task"

quotes.name: Vigilant Drake
quotes.flavor: It can stay aloft for weeks with little or no sleep.

quotes.name: Vanguard of the Rose
quotes.flavor: "No one soul is worth more than Torrezon's salvation. Press on."

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

quotes.name: Ratcatcher Trainee // Pest Problem
quotes.flavor: "Where do they keep coming from?!"

quotes.name: Street Wraith
quotes.flavor: Most of the spirits that haunt Urborg were once ordinary people, even children, twisted beyond recognition by the swamp's corrupted mana.

quotes.name: Mechanized Production
quotes.flavor:
"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Blazing Archon
quotes.flavor:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

quotes.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
quotes.flavor: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

quotes.name: Midnight Reaper
quotes.flavor: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

quotes.name: Gelectrode
quotes.flavor:
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

quotes.name: Blade Splicer
quotes.flavor: "Flesh is a betrayal of the self."

quotes.name: Zuko's Exile
quotes.flavor: As punishment for his disobedience, Zuko was banished and sent to capture the Avatar. Only then could he return home with his honor.

quotes.name: Frozen Shade
quotes.flavor:
"There are some qualities—some incorporate things,
That have a double life, which thus is made
A type of that twin entity which springs
From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"The best way to learn from a book on pyromancy is to burn it."
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Canopy Spider
quotes.flavor: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

quotes.name: Affectionate Indrik
quotes.flavor: The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: Occasionally members of the Institute of Arcane Study acquire a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor:
"Yes, it's huge and strong and breathes fire. But we're smart!"
—Tadith the Wise, last words

quotes.name: Drudge Skeletons
quotes.flavor:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral, *Necromancer's Handbook*

quotes.name: Steelshaper's Gift
quotes.flavor: Some blades seek their own wielders.

quotes.name: Loam Lion
quotes.flavor: ゼンディカーでは、今日の草原は明日の密林であり、狩場も天気と同じぐらいにすぐ変わってしまう。

quotes.name: Rise from the Tides
quotes.flavor:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Victor Timely, Wily Tycoon
quotes.flavor: "No time like the present. No present like the future."

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Stun
quotes.flavor:
"They certainly are well protected. Too bad for them they're not well balanced."
—Sisay

quotes.name: Flawless Maneuver
quotes.flavor: "The Fire Lord is Aang's fight. We need to stay focused on stopping that fleet from burning down the Earth Kingdom."

quotes.name: Haunting Misery
quotes.flavor:
"I am condemned without end."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Quarrel
quotes.flavor: The shoving and name-calling was all in good fun, and Bilbo began to finally view the Dwarves as companions instead of strangers.

quotes.name: Worthy Knight
quotes.flavor: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.

quotes.name: Triskaidekaphile
quotes.flavor: She's always willing to lend a hand. It just won't be her own.

quotes.name: Farewell
quotes.flavor: "I don't want to go."

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor: "Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: Word of Seizing
quotes.flavor: "Obey!"

quotes.name: Rust Goliath
quotes.flavor:
"You know those seedpods cluttering the eastern approach? I've got an idea . . . ."
—Calle, Urzan sergeant

quotes.name: Serpent of Yawning Depths
quotes.flavor:
"Gleams like moonlight on water drew us through the storm and toward our doom."
—Siona, captain of the *Pyleas*

quotes.name: Supplant Form
quotes.flavor:
"Ice can be shaped to any form, even the whisper of a memory."
—Mytha, Temur shaman

quotes.name: Wildfire
quotes.flavor: Fire is always at the top of the food chain, and it has a *big* appetite.

quotes.name: Ghostfire Blade
quotes.flavor: If you fear the dragon's fire, you are unworthy to wield it.

quotes.name: Ogre Sentry
quotes.flavor:
"You have to appreciate the genius of it. Why bother building defenses when you can just fill the pass with angry ogres?"
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Icatian Scout
quotes.flavor:
"Let it be known that Ailis Connaut acted with honor and bravery in the defense of the town of Montford, risking her life to scout the enemy's position . . . ."
—Proclamation granting knighthood

quotes.name: Secret Plans
quotes.flavor: Rakshasa trade in secrets, amassing wealth from their careful revelation.

quotes.name: Shuri, the Black Panther
quotes.flavor: "Monster! You've faced the muscle of Wakanda. Now face its claws."

quotes.name: Hair-Strung Koto
quotes.flavor:
"The Kami War drove many members of Konda's court insane. As their spiritual world turned against them, so too did their minds turn from reality."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Deflection
quotes.flavor:
Up and down,
over and through,
back around—
the joke's on you.

quotes.name: Well of Lost Dreams
quotes.flavor: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

quotes.name: Treasure Vault
quotes.flavor: There is wealth enough inside to cause the rise and the ruin of dynasties.

quotes.name: Stormcatch Mentor
quotes.flavor: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"

quotes.name: Lethal Vapors
quotes.flavor: The vapors infiltrate every crevice, poison every lung, and snuff out every life.

quotes.name: Sudden Death
quotes.flavor: Some mages tapped into the time rifts, forcing upon others alternate timelines in which unimaginable horrors befall them.

quotes.name: Clock of Omens
quotes.flavor: Most clocks measure time, but a few measure everything.

quotes.name: Aether Tunnel
quotes.flavor: If you can't find a doorway, make one.

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

quotes.name: Strider Harness
quotes.flavor:
"Because the giant, implacable death lizard wasn't scary enough already."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Mine Collapse
quotes.flavor: "Good ol' rock," muttered Rhirhok as the shaking began. "Nice ol' rock . . . ."

quotes.name: Tormented Soul
quotes.flavor: Those who raged most bitterly at the world in life are cursed to roam the nether realms in death.

quotes.name: Vengeful Devil
quotes.flavor: Devils love adding injury to injury.

quotes.name: Tempest of Light
quotes.flavor: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may take its course."

quotes.name: Gelectrode
quotes.flavor:
"Diametrically opposing energies in self-sealed plasmodermic bubbles make great pets!"
—Trivaz, Izzet mage

quotes.name: Nefarious Imp
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: It listens to all of their plans and plots creative ways to turn them to ruin.

quotes.name: Cemetery Recruitment
quotes.flavor: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

quotes.name: Fabled Passage
quotes.flavor: For many children, the wonder of their first warp is a lifelong inspiration.

quotes.name: Mortivore
quotes.flavor: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

quotes.name: Mystical Tutor
quotes.flavor: "Now, did I file that away under 'C' for 'Combo' or 'F' for 'Finisher?'"

quotes.name: Geier Reach Bandit // Vildin-Pack Alpha
quotes.flavor: The cathars realized they had not tracked her—she had led them here.

quotes.name: Bury in Books
quotes.flavor: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

quotes.name: Kuja, Genome Sorcerer // Trance Kuja, Fate Defied
quotes.flavor: "Yes, this is it! This is the power I've always wanted!"

quotes.name: Volcanic Dragon
quotes.flavor: Sometimes an eruption in Shiv produces something more dangerous than a mere river of molten rock.

quotes.name: Finale of Devastation
quotes.flavor: Some spells sing a quiet tune. Others roar.

quotes.name: Pulse Tracker
quotes.flavor: Pulse trackers terrorize adventurers, driving them through the jungle toward certain death at the gates of Malakir.

quotes.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

quotes.name: Relief Captain
quotes.flavor: Sometimes gestures of support are small. Sometimes not.

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: "How did we get up so high so quick?" asked Clara, "Clever staircase. It's taller on the inside," replied the Doctor.

quotes.name: Enshrined Memories
quotes.flavor:
"The race is run in the mind before the first step is taken."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

quotes.name: Galvanic Iteration
quotes.flavor: Better potent than predictable.

quotes.name: Ghirapur Orrery
quotes.flavor: This detailed model allows the edificers to examine the city from every angle.

quotes.name: Magnetic Flux
quotes.flavor: After the researcher's astonishing success, his assistants spent six hours finding a way to return the specimens safely to the ground.

quotes.name: Cyclonic Rift
quotes.flavor: The Izzet specialize in unnatural disaster.

quotes.name: Weaselback Redcap
quotes.flavor:
"I would rather cast myself into the abyss than let my blood stain the cap of those monsters."
—Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw

quotes.name: Carpet of Flowers
quotes.flavor:
"Love is a form of hope and, like hope, love abides in the face of everything."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Horned Troll
quotes.flavor: Sword hilts jut from some trolls' bodies where wounds healed so fast that the weapons were trapped inside.

quotes.name: Lion's Eye Diamond
quotes.flavor:
Held in the lion's eye
—Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, one person's windfall usually starts with another person lying face down in the mud.

quotes.name: Multani's Harmony
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to paradise."

quotes.name: Polymorph
quotes.flavor: "Ahh! Opposable digits!"

quotes.name: Renewed Faith
quotes.flavor: Skepticism fades in the face of the miraculous.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Greater Auramancy
quotes.flavor: "The wonders of Nyx do not belong solely to the gods."

quotes.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
quotes.flavor: It loves to eat all things crispy, crunchy, and cheddar flavored.

quotes.name: Zuko, Avatar Hunter
quotes.flavor: "Once I deliver the Avatar to my father, he will welcome me home with honor and restore my rightful place on the throne."

quotes.name: Undying Malice
quotes.flavor: Lazlo was going to find the jerks who stabbed him in the back and stab them in their fronts.

quotes.name: Westvale Abbey // Ormendahl, Profane Prince
quotes.flavor: With Griselbrand gone, the Skirsdag eagerly awaited another demon to claim their devotion. Ormendahl did not make them wait long.

quotes.name: Deafening Clarion
quotes.flavor:
"Commander, what's the signal to attack?"
"You'll know."

quotes.name: Dismiss into Dream
quotes.flavor:
"You trust in the shadows of a breeze."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

quotes.name: Temple of Epiphany
quotes.flavor:
"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri

quotes.name: Wild Slash
quotes.flavor: Never mistake deception for cleverness.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Curse of Surveillance
quotes.flavor: For every eye gouged out, two blinked open.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

quotes.name: Keldon Vandals
quotes.flavor: Keldons divide all their spoils into two groups: trophies and catapult ammunition.

quotes.name: Leyline Prowler
quotes.flavor: It feeds on the dark energies that course through the deep world—and on any other creature lured by the leyline's pull.

quotes.name: Baleful Force
quotes.flavor:
"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Scaled Nurturer
quotes.flavor: A book may plant an idea in a body, but it's the body that cultivates the idea.

quotes.name: Flood of Tears
quotes.flavor:
"I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean."
—Mu Yanling

quotes.name: Lim-Dûl's High Guard
quotes.flavor:
"The Guard will forever stand ready. For them, death is merely an inconvenience, not an ending."
—Chaeska, keeper of Tresserhorn

quotes.name: Unnatural Growth
quotes.flavor: With the cycles of day and night unspooled, the twisted sway of the moon only grew. And grew.

quotes.name: Crown of Awe
quotes.flavor: "Honor, guide my step."
